item_name: Rothco Canvas Jumbo Mechanic Tool Bag
item_short_desc: Optimize your tool storage with Rothco’s Canvas Jumbo Mechanic Tool Bag. Crafted from heavyweight cotton canvas, this tool bag offers ample space for your essentials. With two outer snap pockets and twelve internal organizer pockets, it ensures efficient organization of tools and accessories. The tool bag measures 17.5 Inch X 9.5 Inch X 6.5, providing generous storage capacity. Sturdy web carry handles make it easy to transport, while the polyester zipper ensures secure closure.
